Good morning. Thank you for the appeal and for proposing to draw my character!
As this is a new year, would you draw my character with the theme of being hopeful for the new year 2024.
As you know 2024 is year of the dragon, so it fits the theme of my character (she is a vampiric dragon)

Personality:
She is gentle on the inside, but is sly and unreadable on the outside.
She went through many things in her past and would like to be strong for herself and her friends.

Pose:
Please go with poses that emphasizes her nature. 
It's okay to be revealing or suggestive (I would love it! <3) but I don't want her to be sleazy.

I will leave the rest to your imagination, please draw as you like, keeping in mind a few points above!
